lineage.description: Population counts from the 2010 census were spatially integrated with administrative county boundaries and a 1km coastal buffer zone to quantify the proportion of population residing in coastal proximity across American Samoa. The analysis combines census enumeration data with geographic information systems processing to create exposure inventories for coastal risk assessment.
